# Tempest plugins docs

> The Tempest plugins for Hytale servers (economy, quests, crates, holograms, battle pass, jobs, leveling with Endless Leveling and MMO Skill Tree, and more): a server guide made from the game (commands, permissions, every setting, what players read) and the Java API.


## Welcome
- [Introduction](index.md): Run the Tempest plugins on your Hytale server, and build on them.

## Server guide
- [Server guide](server-guide.md): How the Tempest plugins work in game, for server owners and admins: commands, permissions, every setting and what players see.
- [All commands and permissions](guide-commands.md): Every command of every Tempest plugin, and who can use it.
- [Core](guide-core.md): The base: /tempest, /guide, the board, the mailbox, rank perks, the map, boosters.
- [Economy (Coins)](guide-economy.md): Wallets, coins, banks, daily rewards and ore and monster gold.
- [Holograms](guide-holograms.md): Floating text and top lists.
- [Shop](guide-shop.md): The server shop, stalls and their shelves.
- [Crates](guide-crates.md): Crates, keys, prizes and crate blocks.
- [Quests](guide-quests.md): Quests, achievements, ranks, the daily sweep and server quests.
- [Battle pass](guide-pass.md): Seasons, tiers, free and premium rewards.
- [Events](guide-events.md): Server events with boosts, community goals and the server fund.
- [Contracts and bounties](guide-contracts.md): Player contracts, server orders, the market, ranks and bounties.
- [Town projects](guide-projects.md): Buildings the players build together.
- [Town](guide-town.md): Features the town unlocks, and the mayor.
- [Jobs](guide-jobs.md): Paid work with job levels.
- [Trade](guide-trade.md): Safe trades between players.
- [Claims](guide-claims.md): Land claims for parties: protection, the claim page and map, taxes and upkeep.
- [Slot machines](guide-slots.md)
- [Lottery](guide-lottery.md)
- [Coinflip](guide-coinflip.md)
- [Leveling mods for server owners](leveling-mods.md): What the Tempest plugins do with Endless Leveling and MMO Skill Tree, alone or together, and where it is set.
- [Economies for server owners](economies.md): Which economy the Tempest plugins pay into: Tempest Economy, or one you already run through VaultUnlocked (GlymeraMerchant, Ecotale and others).

## Developers: start here
- [Quick start](quick-start.md): From an empty plugin to one that pays players and reads their level, in five steps.
- [Link your mod to Tempest](link-your-mod.md): Make your leveling, party, claims or gameplay mod work with all 16 Tempest plugins by talking to Tempest Core once.
- [Setting up a plugin](setup.md): Dependencies, Registrations, config files and which Core is installed.
- [API versions](versions.md): What each Core API version added, to check before you use it.

## Core API
- [Money](money.md): The server's economy, whichever plugin keeps it, and what only Tempest Economy (Coins) has.
- [Player actions](actions.md): Hear what players do in every Tempest plugin, and report your own.
- [Settings and menus](settings.md): A /tempest settings tab for your plugin, menu themes, editions, languages and help pages.
- [Boards, HUD and placeholders](hud.md): Leaderboards, the money counter and progress bars, placeholders and announcements.
- [Rewards, mail and boosts](rewards.md): Item and command rewards, the mailbox, boosts for a while and rank perks.
- [Land claims](claims.md): Who owns a place and what a player may do there, from Tempest Claims or Simple Claims.
- [Map, hub, town and demand](world.md): Places on the world map, the Tempest hub, features the town unlocks and items the server wants.
- [Safety and helpers](safety.md): Admin logs, rate limits, play limits, AFK checks, the doctor and crash-safe files.

## Leveling and skills API
- [Player levels](levels.md): Levels from Endless Leveling or MMO Skill Tree, through one API.
- [Skills (MMO Skill Tree)](skills.md): Skill levels, skill XP, achievements, quests and NPC talks.

## Plugin APIs
- [Quests](quests.md): Your own kinds of goals, goals shipped with your mod, progress and custom triggers.
- [Crates](crates.md)
- [Holograms](holograms.md): Floating text, items, statues and rankings.
- [Coinflip](coinflip.md): Rooms, and your own kind of room.
- [Jobs](jobs.md): Pay job work from any mod.
- [Town projects](projects.md): The buildings players build together, and their states.
- [Battle pass](pass.md)
- [Lottery, slots and shop](games.md)
